column1: # One character per line, tab separated:
# This file is the thing to edit. scripts/build-mnemonics.py joins in pinyin,
# rank, decomposition and component glosses from data/raw/ and writes
# zh-hsk1.jsonl plus zh-hsk1.preview.md. Keep the meaning to the sense the
# course teaches; the dictionary's other senses belong in the dictionary.
# Drafts, not doctrine: a mnemonic is a memory hook, not an etymology. Edit
# freely, keep the ones that fire, replace the ones that do not.

column4: The white (白) spoon (勺) on the table is obviously mine — duh. It marks who owns what.
A single flat line: one. Say ee — one clean stroke, nothing to remember.
The sun (日) stands on a foot (疋) at noon: it IS exactly here, sure.
A bird flaps up into a ceiling (一 over the wings): no way. Boo — refused.
A baby swaddled and done up: the action is wrapped, finished. Luh — it is over.
Your talent (才) is rooted in the earth (土): you are AT that spot.
Two legs mid-stride: a person. A wren is a tiny person with a tail.
A hand holding meat (月): I HAVE dinner. Yo, it is mine.
My hand (扌) grips a halberd (戈): I stand at war. Wǒ — I.
A person (亻) plus also (也): him too. Ta — he is off.
Walk (辶) up to the writing (文) and point: THIS one.
One person (人) on a stick (丨): a single item. One grunt — guh — per piece.
People (亻) pouring through a door (门): a crowd. -men makes many.
A line (丨) straight through a box (口): dead centre, like a gong in the town square.
Ripe wheat (未) with grain (丷) bends toward you: the harvest COMES. Lái — lie down here.
A stroke above the line: up. Shàng — a rising note.
A person (人) with arms stretched wide (一): BIG. Dah — ta-da!
Grain (禾) in every mouth (口): harmony. Hé — her, and everyone else too.
Jade (玉) kept inside the borders (囗): the country's treasure.
Speech (讠) pouring out in a stream (兑): say it.
The sun (日) moves one inch (寸): that is time. Sure — time flies.
A sprout (屮) pushes out of its pot (凵): out. Chew your way through the lid.
People (人) gather like clouds (云): together we CAN. Huì — a meeting.
A person (亻) standing there: YOU. I point at your knee.
A hand (又) measuring an inch (寸): exactly right. Duì — correct.
A shoot (屮) breaks through the soil (土): life begins.
A bear (厶 head, ⺼ body, 匕匕 claws) can do anything. Néng — able.
A baby with arms out and legs wrapped: child.
That city over there (阝). Nah — not this one, THAT one.
A stroke below the line: down. Xià — the low note.
A man (干) carries the harvest home: another YEAR.
Behind the mouth (口) that speaks comes the reply: AFTER you. Hòu — hoe the row behind.
A person (亻) starts something new (乍): makes it. Zuò — do it.
Measure the field (田) in the soil (土): the village INSIDE the fields, a li across.
A roof (宀) over a pig (豕): home, where the family eats.
Two nights (夕夕) in a row: many days, much work.
A tiny hook and a private dot: a small question hanging in the air. Meh — what?
Soil (土) on your feet and off you GO. Qù — chew up the road.
A roof (冖) over a child (子), sparks (⺍) of knowledge above: study.
Everyone in the city (阝): ALL of them. Dōu — doh, the whole lot.
One common (凡) mouth (口) for all: SAME. Tóng — same tongue.
Jade (王) appears the moment you SEE (见) it.
Water (氵) and a hand (殳) closing on nothing: I have NOT. Méi — may not.
A face drawn around an eye: face, surface.
You lift YOURSELF (己) and walk (走) up: rise.
A hand (手) shading the eye (目): look far. Kàn — can you see?
Above (一) the big person (大) is the sky.
Eight (八) pieces cut by a knife (刀): divide. Fēn — fun to share.
Woman (女) with child (子): good. Hǎo — how good.
A hook with two small dots: small.
This (此) and two (二) more: SOME.
A tree (木) shaped like a sheep (羊): shape, pattern.
Woman (女) also (也): she too.
A line at the tree's base (木 plus 一): the ROOT, the origin.
The dog (chien) runs in FRONT of you.
Two hands (廾) lift the latch (一): OPEN.
You look (相) with your heart (心): think, and want.
Wood (木) on a frame (几): a machine. Jī — gee, it works.
A cross: ten. Sure, ten fingers' worth.
A workman's spade: work. Gōng — the gong that starts the shift.
Sun (日) and moon (月) together: bright.
Three parallel lines: three.
Two horns (丷) over the sky (天): the gate CLOSES.
Fire (灬) marks a DOT. Diǎn — a dot on the clock.
A tall palace tower: HIGH.
Step (彳) after step (艮): VERY far.
An eye on legs: SEE. Jiàn — I see you, Jen.
Ten (十) people (亻) all asking: WHAT?
Two lines: two. Èr — are there two?
Fruit (田) on a tree (木).
A bird settling into its nest at sunset: west.
A crescent moon: month.
Speech (讠) from a tongue (舌): words.
A mouth in a box, going round: return.
A bent old person with long hair and a cane: old. Lǎo — low, close to the ground.
A foot (止) stepping ahead of a person (儿): first.
A child with legs: son.
The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木): east.
A river running between two banks: water.
At night (夕) a mouth (口) calls your NAME.
A small table (几) with things to count: how many?
Speech (讠) plus person (人): I know that person by their words.
A thread (糸) tying things together: a system, a link.
A person breathing steam: air, qi.
A hand (扌) with a nail (丁): HIT it.
A woman seated sideways.
A child (儿) in a room with four walls (囗): four.
Lightning (乚) flashing from a cloud: electricity.
A pinch of grains: LITTLE. Shǎo — show me just a few.
A big (大) person with a dot: TOO big.
Two fish (冉) on one line (一): caught AGAIN.
A person (亻) causing (故) things to happen: DO.
Its (其) own month (月): a set PERIOD.
A cross with an extra bar: five.
A pen making marks on paper: book. Shū — shoe-shaped pages.
A mouth (口) and an axe (斤): LISTEN, or else.
A person (亻) who hosts (主): they LIVE here.
Two people (匕匕) standing back to back: north.
Under a roof (冖) you SEE (见) the light: wake up, feel.
A knife (刂) and a banner (帀): the teacher leads.
A mouth saying it right NOW.
A finished (完) place (阝): a walled courtyard.
Speech (讠) plus only (只): I only know the words.
A person (亻) standing and waiting.
A bird flapping its wings: fly.
A cart with two wheels seen from above: vehicle.
A body (月) putting on (又) a coat: clothes.
A new (乍) heart (心) wonders: HOW?
A mouth (口) and ni: and what about...? Ne.
A mouth (口) with a hook: CALL out.
Sunlight (景) with streaks (彡): a shadow.
A child (子) under a roof (宀) learning characters.
A hand (爫) brings a friend (友) under the roof (冖): love.
A bright (冏) market stall: commerce.
Speech (讠) plus green (青): PLEASE.
An altar (礻) and an eye (见): observe.
A bent elbow: nine.
Under a cover (冖), a hand (与): WRITE.
Two lines dividing: eight.
A mouth (口) and a horse (马): a question.
A mouth (口) begging (乞) for food: EAT.
A lid (亠) over eight (八): six.
An arrow (矢) in a box (匸): the doctor pulls it out.
A mouth (口) shouting a number.
The speech (讠) of me (吾): my language.
A line with a hook: seven.
Sparks (⺍) over a base: interest catches, things thrive.
The sun (日) born (生) into the night: a star.
A tall capital building on a hill.
Grains of rice scattered.
Each (各) person under the roof (宀) is a guest.
Two hands (又又) joined: friend.
Metal (钅) coins: money.
Held (执) over fire (灬): HOT.
Two people (从) on the earth (土): sit.
A wooden (木) building where people meet (交): school.
Flesh (⺼) with a box (凶): the brain.
Speech (讠) to a bird (隹): WHO are you?
A mouth (口) plus that (那): WHICH?
Drums (壴) and a mouth (口): joy.
Wings flapping again and again: practice.
A hand (又) and a yawn (欠): happy.
Ice (冫) plus a command (令): COLD.
The Han river (氵): Chinese.
A dress: clothes.
Woman (女) with a horse (马): MAMA.
Speech (讠) sold (卖) by the page: READ.
A coin and a head: BUY. Mǎi — my money.
A mountain (山) of evenings (夕): years pass.
A clod of earth (土): a PIECE.
Woman (女) and also (且): elder sister.
An oil lamp under a roof: bright.
Two moons (月月) side by side: friends.
Speech (讠) shot (射) at you: THANKS.
Metal (钅) in the middle (中): a bell, a clock.
Drops falling from a cloud: rain.
Food (饣) turned (反) into a meal.
Eyes (目) drooping (垂): sleep.
A mouth (口) and a question (曷): DRINK?
The sun directly overhead: noon.
A building (广) occupied (占): a shop.
Father (父) plus ba: DAD.
Tall (卓) wood (木): a table.
Grass (艹) picked (采): vegetables.
Grass (艹), a person (人), a tree (木): tea.
Animal (犭) plus a phrase (句): DOG.
Wood (木) plus not (不): a cup — though not wooden.
Grain (禾) paid regularly (且): rent.
The sun (日) newly (乍) set: YESTERDAY.
Water (氵) plus a ticket (票): FLOAT.
Wood (木) plus strange (奇): a chair.
Animal (犭) in the sprouts (苗): CAT.
A mouth (口) calling out: HEY.
Grass (艹) plus flat (平): apple.
